parsed.change_summary: Added a check to prevent integer overflow in the calculation of abs(v[i] - h). If the result exceeds INT_MAX, it is set to INT_MAX.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger described in the finding no longer works because the code now checks if the result of abs(v[i] - h) exceeds INT_MAX. If it does, the value is set to INT_MAX instead of allowing the overflow to occur. This prevents the integer overflow from happening.
parsed.behavior_changes: If the absolute difference between v[i] and h exceeds INT_MAX, the value is now set to INT_MAX instead of causing an overflow. This change ensures that the program does not crash or produce incorrect results due to overflow.
